messages.subject: Last chance to apply for postdocs
parts:
Hi all. We have 2 open postdoc opportunities in our research group at Columbia; see here:
http://andrewgelman.com/2015/10/22/3-postdoc-opportunities-you-cant-miss-here-in-our-group-at-columbia-apply-now-dont-miss-out/
It would be great to see people who can contribute to Stan as part of this research.
So if you are interested, apply right away! Please send cv, application letter, and any papers of yours to me, and have 3 letters of recommendation sent to me too.
See you,
Andrew
